misses.root_cause: PHP trait usage in test hierarchy was not linked via direct class inheritance edges in the static graph.
misses.remediation: Enhance PHP extractor to emit USES_TRAIT edges and connect trait methods to consuming class hierarchies.

misses.root_cause: Event listener accesses Node::getId() from untyped event payload; receiver type was not propagated interprocedurally.
misses.remediation: Deploy TypeFlowIndex to resolve event payload parameter annotations (@param GenericEvent $event).

misses.root_cause: Node instance stored in Sabre DAV plugin property without explicit property type hint; receiver resolved as ambiguous.
misses.remediation: Extract PHPDoc @var annotations on class properties during type inference.

misses.root_cause: Untyped node parameter passed through Sabre tree navigation methods.
misses.remediation: Trace method arguments from caller call-site types to callee parameters.

misses.root_cause: Distant property access getId() on untyped receiver.
misses.remediation: TypeFlowIndex receiver propagation for Sabre Node hierarchy.

misses.root_cause: TagService receives NodeInterface; implementation implements NodeInterface but resolution was ambiguous.
misses.remediation: Compute implements closure between NodeInterface and Node concrete class in TypeFlowIndex.

misses.root_cause: Test file was 2 hops away through TagService, which was pruned when TagService was dropped from pool.
misses.remediation: Recovering TagService via TypeFlowIndex will automatically recover TagServiceTest via source_to_test edge.

misses.root_cause: Listener unwraps Node entity from event object without explicit variable type hint.
misses.remediation: Event-to-payload entity mapping in NextcloudAdapter.

misses.root_cause: Sabre version collection iterates child nodes using untyped foreach loop.
misses.remediation: Array/collection element type tracking in TypeFlowIndex.

misses.root_cause: Background job receives fileId scalar integer from cron/job queue and loads Node dynamically.
misses.remediation: Recognize background job handlers as boundary entry points consuming entity IDs.

misses.root_cause: Traversal policy under HIGH fanout mode pruned 2-hop storage updater path.
misses.remediation: GraphDegreeAnalyzer will prevent artificial fanout escalation by calculating true seed edge degree.

misses.root_cause: Dynamic template node instantiation via factory method without return type annotation.
misses.remediation: Add factory method return type resolution in TypeFlowIndex.

misses.root_cause: Generator was 2 hops away via FileView and was pruned due to degree thresholding.
misses.remediation: Preserve operation-compatible second hop expansion when seed degree is within bounds.

misses.root_cause: MP3 preview provider depended on Generator.php; dropped cascadingly.

misses.root_cause: Public template class wraps internal Node instance without typed property hint.
misses.remediation: Constructor injection and property assignment type tracking.

misses.root_cause: Test class 2 hops away was truncated under HIGH fanout mode.
misses.remediation: True seed degree calculation in GraphDegreeAnalyzer.
